text:
Residents:
Felix (40s): Weekdays home AM, out 1:40 PM–11 PM. Weekends off, errands midday. Hobbies: movies, houseplants.
Aisha (50s): WFH 9 AM–5:30 PM weekdays. Weekends sleep in, errands midday. Hobbies: friends, meditation, movies.
Ines (30s): WFH 9 AM–5:30 PM weekdays. Weekends sleep in, errands midday. Hobbies: baking, reading, running.

Object Locations & Routines:
Felix’s items (backpack, jacket, keys, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, umbrella, wallet, water bottle) are at the entry (hook/table/floor) in the morning. They leave the house around 16:00 when he leaves for work and return around 00:00. His personal dishes (bowl, glass, mug, plate) are in the kitchen sink or cupboard in the morning, moved to the cupboard by 12:00, and returned to the sink/table by 16:00.

Aisha’s and Ines’s phones are on their respective nightstands (b2/b3) overnight. They are removed from the house around 08:00 for work/errands and return by 12:00. Aisha’s laptop is on her desk (b2) during work hours (12:00–16:00) and moved to the floor or nightstand in the evening. Ines’s headphones and water bottle are on her desk (b3) during work hours and moved to the nightstand or kitchen in the evening.

Shared kitchen items (cutting board, knife, pan, pot, recipe book, spatula, snack bowl) are in the cupboard or pantry overnight. They are moved to the counter or sink during the day (12:00–20:00) for cooking/cleaning and returned to storage by 00:00.

Personal dishes for Aisha and Ines (bowls, glasses, mugs, plates) are in the cupboard overnight. They are moved to the sink, dish rack, or kitchen table during the day and returned to the cupboard by 00:00.

Notes:
- Felix is out of the house from ~16:00 to ~00:00 on weekdays.
- Aisha and Ines are home all day on weekdays, working from 9 AM to 5:30 PM.
- No items have been taken out of the house permanently; all "not in any room" items returned by the next patrol.
- Pockets and bags are not inspected.
- Aisha’s razor is typically on the bathroom shelf, moved to the sink in the morning.
- The shared vacuum cleaner is stored on the storage floor, moved to the living room floor in the evening.
- The shared remote is on the TV stand overnight, moved to the couch in the evening.
- The shared blanket is on the couch overnight, moved to the armchair in the evening.
- Ines’s keys are typically on the entry table, moved to the entry hook in the evening.
- Aisha’s pen is on her desk during work hours, moved to the dresser in the evening.
- On weekends, Ines’s jacket, keys, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, and wallet are taken out of the house around 12:00 for errands and return by 16:00.
- Aisha’s phone is taken out of the house around 16:00 on weekends and returns by 20:00.
- Felix’s book and glasses move from the nightstand to the armchair in the afternoon and back to the nightstand in the evening.
- Shared baking items (tray, mixing bowl) move from pantry to sink in the evening for Ines’s baking.
